descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94513 AC 9, AC 10; UAT TC-25 ER 1 · “they don't share a session token, but both remain valid at once”.

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S03 Existing specs: a second sign-in leaves the first signed in, and the two devices hold separate sessions

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in. (UAT TC-25 step 1; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 9; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T1 Each device goes through its own email-code sign-in (a new device always asks for a code). The two do not share a session token, and both stay valid at once. (TFA-94513 AC 6; TFA-94513 AC 10; UAT TC-25 step 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh account. Device one is an API client signed in with its own email code (createAuthSession)

When Device two signs in through the sign-in form with its own code (sign-in-devices.spec.ts); and two API sign-ins with two codes, phone then laptop (session-security.spec.ts)

Then Device one's session still answers settings:get; the two JWTs name different sessions, and both answer whoAmI and get-session

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in e2e/sign-in-devices.spec.ts and e2e/api/session-security.spec.ts. Evidence for the sign-in half of U1/T1 only: neither looks at a device's screen afterwards, the other order (phone second) or a real phone. That a new device is asked for a code is S26 and S13 cp0

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

  • api/session-security.spec.ts [api] — two devices hold two sessions; a new sign-in never ends an older one — expected
  • sign-in-devices.spec.ts [chromium] — signing in on a second device leaves the first signed in — expected
